title: Just 3D Potions (Punchy! 1.21 Backport)
description: This project is a backport for 1.21 of Just 3D Potions (Punchy!) by NagiTheBurgermuncher. Fancy 3D potions! Compatible with Punchy!
body:
This resource pack is the backported version from **NagiTheBurgermuncher's work**, which makes unique 3D models and animations for every potion in the game!

# Why is there a backport?

Since the original work uses features from 1.21.5 That does not exist in the previous version, the models did not work correctly. Just like the original work, `Punchy!` is required.

# Are there differences with the original?

The only difference due to a limitation with early 1.21 is that every item will have only one model, so all potions always look 3D. In the original work, you'll see potions look 3D in hand but 2D on everywhere else. Also, the drinking animation is slightly different.

Anyway, enjoy the resource pack and also check out the original work! [Just 3D Potions (Punchy!)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/just-3d-potions)
